articles.title: LeBron's Free Agency: No Rush for a 22-Time All-Star
articles.summary: Three weeks into free agency, LeBron James still hasn't picked a team. His agent Rich Paul says it's a 'business choice' and won't be rushed. The 41-year-old's decision could reshape the NBA—teams like the Warriors and 76ers are waiting.

articles.title: From Refugee Camps to Harrisburg: Soccer Binds a Bhutanese Community
articles.summary: For Nepali-speaking Bhutanese refugees in Harrisburg, Pa., soccer is a lifeline. A youth program and an annual tournament honor a coach from the camps, where the sport helped cope with trauma. Now, the community faces new threats of deportation.

articles.title: Burnham's First Cabinet: Cost-of-Living Crisis Takes Center Stage
articles.summary: New UK PM Andy Burnham chaired his first cabinet, promising a 'cost of living government.' But his plan to scrap a digital ID scheme to fund it sparked a row over public finances. Surprise pick John Healey as chancellor pledged fiscal discipline.
